evals.name: table_formatting
evals.prompt:
Format this markdown table so it's readable:
| Name | Age |
|---|---|
| John | 25 |
evals.expected_output: A properly formatted markdown table with aligned columns

evals.name: line_break_fixing
evals.prompt:
Fix the line breaks in this markdown:
# Heading## Subheading
- Item 1
- Item 2
evals.expected_output: Markdown with proper blank lines between elements

evals.name: structure_formatting
evals.prompt:
Format this badly structured markdown:
```
# Title
Some text without proper spacing.

## Subtitle
More text here.
```

evals.name: check_mode
evals.description: Verify that check mode doesn't modify files
evals.command: echo '# Test' > /tmp/check_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py /tmp/check_test.md && test $(cat /tmp/check_test.md) = '# Test'

evals.name: write_mode
evals.command: echo '# Heading## Subheading' > /tmp/write_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py --write /tmp/write_test.md && grep -q '## Subheading' /tmp/write_test.md

evals.name: dry_run_mode
evals.description: Verify that dry-run shows changes without modifying
evals.command: echo '# Heading## Subheading' > /tmp/dry_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py --dry-run /tmp/dry_test.md 2>&1 | grep -q 'Changes for'

evals.name: technical_mode
evals.description: Verify technical mode uses 120 char line width
evals.command: echo 'A very long line that would normally wrap at 80 characters but should stay together in technical mode because it contains code or equations.' | python scripts/format_and_lint.py --technical | wc -c

evals.name: fix_option_help
evals.description: Verify --fix help text mentions both Prettier and markdownlint

evals.name: fix_applies_both_fixes
evals.description: Verify --fix applies both Prettier formatting and markdownlint fixes
evals.command:
cat > /tmp/fix_test.md << 'EOF' && python scripts/format_and_lint.py --fix /tmp/fix_test.md && cat /tmp/fix_test.md | grep -q '## Subheading' && echo 'SUCCESS' || echo 'FAIL'
# Heading: with colon## Subheading

Some content.
EOF
